validation_profile.comment: Thresholds for automated checks. They catch defects in the animation data (jumps, slides, penetration, asymmetry). They do not certify exercise technique; that needs a qualified human.
validation_profile.max_hand_into_bar_comment: The skin of the palm is rigid in this rig. Up to 8 mm of palm pad inside the bar stands for soft tissue pressed flat by the load; more than that, or any finger passing through the bar, is a defect.

technical_cues: Bar over the middle of the foot the whole way
muscle_roles_note: Three levels (Kiệt 15/11): primary = carries the load and produces the main force; secondary = directly assists the movement; stabilizing = holds posture and keeps joints stable. The load is moved by knee extension (quadriceps) and hip extension (gluteus maximus), which by the definition both produce the main force (ExRx lists the gluteus as synergist; at full depth it is a prime hip extensor). Adductor magnus and soleus assist. Erector spinae and the abdominals brace the trunk, hamstrings act as dynamic stabilisers, the upper trapezius carries the bar shelf.
